title: Stockholm transport projects and municipal services gain named accounts
summary: The E4 bypass, Slussen redevelopment and Stockholm municipality distinguish scheduled openings, transferred assets, adjustment work and bounded service observations. Eligible identities reach 68 projects and 35 places, not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Seventeen primary-source records inspected November 22. December 6 is a scheduled partial road opening; terminal handover is not passenger service. Waterworks adjustments, historical groundwater submissions, annual sampling and survey-method pages retain their exact dates and limits. Swedish interpretation is by the author; PDF visual verification was unavailable.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
